baselineModification: Only old camera horizon input cap raised from 0.75 to 1.0 s. All other old forecasting/refusal behavior preserved.

method.origins: Every eligible origin in each fixed schedule, including refused and unscorable cases.
method.scores: Pixel distance at exact future target, using analytic truth for synthetic paths or interpolated later visual observations for saved replays.
method.selection: Models use previously observed validation targets only. No withheld target, world state, object class or renderer physics enters forecasting.
method.comparison: Read paired means for same-origin improvement; total scored coverage and all-case means are also reported.
method.uncertainty: Empirical envelope is not calibrated. Containment is measured, not promised.
limitations: No physical camera/hand accuracy claim follows from these data.
Saved replay files were inspected during development and are not an independent holdout.
Synthetic holdout coefficients were created after implementation; it is still a small artificial suite, not a representative real-world benchmark.
Intentional human changes and first unseen impacts are not inferable from prior centroids alone.
